$comment: The Worker's redirects (src/worker.ts): a source path, the path it sends to (301). The link check (scripts/links.mjs) reads this table too: a link to a source passes when its target opens a page. /docs is the address apps and old links print: it goes to the help pages (60.12). A help topic whose id changes keeps its old path here, sent to the new one (/help/<old>/ and /ar/help/<old>/). /install/ was the install guides' chooser (60.05): it is the download page now, which lists every guide (60.11); the guides themselves stay at /install/<guide>/. /legal/copyright/ was a legal page (60.07) the site no longer publishes: its address goes to the terms page, so a link printed elsewhere still opens a page.
